backlog.title: Reasoning Reuse via Ephemeral Text Injection (ADR-006 / §53)
backlog.description: Implement the §53 Ephemeral Execution Directive elevated from optional to required by ADR-006 and INV-013. The existing MVP (P1.M1–P1.M8, fully built) captures reasoning in a ReasoningBuffer, freezes and snapshots it, and plumbs the snapshot into RequestBuilder.buildReplacement — but the builder explicitly does NOT read it. This phase closes that gap: the frozen snapshot is rendered to plain text, wrapped in a configurable delimiter fence, and injected as ephemeral, delimited reference context into a non-mutating COPY of the replacement request's Context, so the model conditions its answer on its own prior reasoning rather than answering from scratch. Two new config fields (reasoningInjection, reasoningInjectionDelimiter) gate and configure the directive. The change is confined to src/config/index.ts, src/request/builder.ts, src/provider/proxy.ts, and src/provider/decorator.ts, plus tests and docs. See plan/002_de5c3dc3c05f/architecture/ for validated findings.

milestones.title: Configuration Extension — Directive Config Fields
milestones.description: Add reasoningInjection (boolean, default true) and reasoningInjectionDelimiter ({ open, close }) to all four config surfaces: Config interface, DEFAULT_CONFIG (deep-frozen), validateConfig (strict per-field guards), and loadConfigFromEnv (three new PI_STOP_THINKING_* env vars). This milestone has no behavioral impact until the builder consumes the fields in P2.M2.

tasks.title: Add reasoningInjection + reasoningInjectionDelimiter to Config schema
tasks.description: Extend the Config interface, DEFAULT_CONFIG frozen defaults, and validateConfig strict guards with the two directive-related fields. The existing per-field strict fallback pattern (pick + guard) must be followed: one bad field never invalidates the rest, and invalid values silently fall back to defaults (Appendix K).

subtasks.title: Add fields to Config interface, DEFAULT_CONFIG, and validateConfig
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/002_de5c3dc3c05f/architecture/directive_design.md §6 for exact type definitions and §2 for default delimiter values. The existing Config interface is at src/config/index.ts lines ~16–34; DEFAULT_CONFIG is at ~40 (Object.freeze with deep-frozen supportedProviders array); validateConfig is at ~95 using per-field pick(guard, fallback) helpers.
2. INPUT: The existing Config interface has 8 fields (enabled, shortcut, supportedProviders, transitionTimeoutMs, replacementStartupTimeoutMs, maximumReasoningBufferBytes, telemetryEnabled, diagnosticsLevel). Existing guard helpers: isBool, isNonEmptyString, isNonEmptyStringArray, isPositiveFinite, isPositiveInteger, isDiagnosticsLevel.
3. LOGIC: Implement PRD §47 + Appendix K config additions:
   a) Add to Config interface: `reasoningInjection: boolean` and `reasoningInjectionDelimiter: { open: string; close: string }`.
   b) Add to DEFAULT_CONFIG (deep-frozen): `reasoningInjection: true` and `reasoningInjectionDelimiter: Object.freeze({ open: '---\n[Prior reasoning captured before you were asked to stop thinking]', close: '[End of prior reasoning]\n---' })`. These defaults come from PRD §53 h3.71 and Appendix K YAML (h1.117).
   c) Add to validateConfig: `reasoningInjection: pick(src.reasoningInjection, isBool, DEFAULT_CONFIG.reasoningInjection)`. For the delimiter, add a NEW guard `isOpenCloseShape(v): v is { open: string; close: string }` that checks v is an object with both open and close as non-empty strings. On ANY failure, fall back to the ENTIRE default object (not partial): `reasoningInjectionDelimiter: isOpenCloseShape(src.reasoningInjectionDelimiter) ? { open: src.reasoningInjectionDelimiter.open, close: src.reasoningInjectionDelimiter.close } : { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG.reasoningInjectionDelimiter }`.
   d) DEFAULT_CONFIG must remain Object.freeze'd with the nested delimiter Object.freeze'd (Appendix F: 'Configuration defaults shall be immutable').
4. OUTPUT: Config interface, DEFAULT_CONFIG, and validateConfig now accept and validate the two new fields. No change to loadConfig or loadConfigFromEnv (those are S2).
5. MOCKING: No external services. This is a pure config module with no network/streaming.
6. DOCS: [Mode A] Update JSDoc on the two new Config fields in src/config/index.ts with purpose, default value, and env var name. Keep the existing Appendix H privacy note current (never log reasoning text).

milestones.title: Directive Construction & Integration — Core §53 Implementation
milestones.description: Implement the Ephemeral Execution Directive: render the frozen ReasoningBuffer snapshot to plain text, wrap it in the configured delimiter fence, and inject it as ephemeral reference context into a non-mutating copy of the replacement request's Context. Modify RequestBuilder.buildReplacement (which currently accepts reasoningSnapshot but does NOT read it), thread config through StreamProxy into the builder, and update the decorator call site.

tasks.title: Implement snapshot rendering helper (renderReasoningText)
tasks.description: Add a pure, exported function that renders a frozen ReasoningBuffer snapshot (readonly ThinkingEntry[]) to plain text by offset-ordered concatenation of each entry's content string. This is the seed data for the directive — the buffer is opaque (no summarization, compression, or transformation).

subtasks.title: Add renderReasoningText pure helper to src/request/builder.ts
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/002_de5c3dc3c05f/architecture/directive_design.md §1 for the exact function specification. ThinkingEntry is defined in src/buffer/index.ts as `{ readonly offset: number; readonly timestamp: number; readonly content: string }`. snapshot() returns `readonly ThinkingEntry[]` (frozen array of frozen entry copies, already offset-ordered).
2. INPUT: `reasoningSnapshot: readonly ThinkingEntry[]` — the frozen snapshot from ReasoningBuffer.snapshot(), passed by StreamProxy._launchReplacement (proxy.ts line 890).
3. LOGIC: Implement PRD §53 h3.70 ('What is injected'): render the captured reasoning text as plain text from the frozen snapshot, offset-ordered, unmodified. No deltas, offsets, timestamps, or provider event envelopes are injected — only the rendered reasoning text. The buffer is opaque (§13.4 / h2.41: 'The extension does not interpret reasoning').
   Function signature:
   ```ts
   export function renderReasoningText(entries: readonly ThinkingEntry[]): string
   ```
   Logic: `entries.map(e => e.content).join('')` — the array is already ordered by offset (append-order). Empty snapshot ([]) → '' (empty string → directive omitted by the gate in T2).
   Purity: no side effects, no diagnostics calls, referentially transparent. Export from src/request/builder.ts (same module as RequestBuilder — avoids a new file for a one-liner).
4. OUTPUT: An exported pure function `renderReasoningText(entries: readonly ThinkingEntry[]): string` that P2.M2.T2.S1's buildReplacement will call.
5. MOCKING: No external services. Pure function over plain data.
6. DOCS: [Mode A] JSDoc on the exported function documenting: purpose (PRD §53 'What is injected'), purity, and the opaque-buffer guarantee (no interpretation/compression). No standalone docs subtask.

tasks.title: Modify RequestBuilder for directive injection (gated, non-mutating)
tasks.description: Modify RequestBuilder's constructor to accept the directive config fields and modify buildReplacement to actually READ the reasoningSnapshot: render it to text, gate on config.reasoningInjection && non-empty, construct the directive message with the delimiter fence, inject into a fresh Context COPY (non-mutating), and set a bounded maxTokens. This is the core implementation of PRD §53 and the satisfaction point for INV-013.

subtasks.title: Modify RequestBuilder constructor + buildReplacement for gated directive injection
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/002_de5c3dc3c05f/architecture/directive_design.md for the COMPLETE implementation contract (§§2–5, 8). See plan/002_de5c3dc3c05f/architecture/pi-ai-context-types.md for the Context/Message/UserMessage type shapes. See plan/002_de5c3dc3c05f/architecture/current-impl-state.md for the exact current buildReplacement body (lines 114–119 of builder.ts) and the single call site (proxy.ts line 890).
2. INPUT:
   - From P2.M1.T1.S1: Config interface now has `reasoningInjection: boolean` and `reasoningInjectionDelimiter: { open: string; close: string }` in DEFAULT_CONFIG.
   - From P2.M2.T1.S1: The exported `renderReasoningText(entries: readonly ThinkingEntry[]): string` pure helper.
   - Existing: `ThinkingEntry` type from src/buffer/index.ts; `Context`, `Model<Api>`, `SimpleStreamOptions`, `UserMessage` types from @earendil-works/pi-ai; `DEFAULT_CONFIG` from src/config/index.ts.
   - The current constructor is `constructor(private readonly diagnostics: Diagnostics) {}` (builder.ts line ~90).
   - The current buildReplacement body (builder.ts lines ~114–119) does: `const replacementOptions = { ...options, reasoning: undefined }; diagnostics.debug('request.replacement-built', {}); return { model, context, options: replacementOptions };` — reasoningSnapshot is accepted but NOT read.
3. LOGIC: Implement the §53 Ephemeral Execution Directive (PRD h1.73 h2.176):
   a) CONSTRUCTOR CHANGE: Add two params with defaults matching DEFAULT_CONFIG so existing call sites that omit them remain behavior-preserving:
      ```ts
      constructor(
        private readonly diagnostics: Diagnostics,
        private readonly _reasoningInjection: boolean = DEFAULT_CONFIG.reasoningInjection,
        private readonly _delimiter: { open: string; close: string } = DEFAULT_CONFIG.reasoningInjectionDelimiter,
      ) {}
      ```
   b) buildReplacement MODIFICATION:
      - Call `renderReasoningText(reasoningSnapshot)` to get the rendered text.
      - Gate: `const shouldInject = this._reasoningInjection && rendered.length > 0;` (PRD §53 h3.70: 'If reasoningInjection is disabled or the snapshot is empty, the directive is omitted').
      - WHEN shouldInject is TRUE: construct a directive `UserMessage` (PRD §53 h3.71 delimiter format + h3.72 positioning):
        ```ts
        const directiveMessage: UserMessage = {
          role: 'user',
          content: `${this._delimiter.open}\n${rendered}\n${this._delimiter.close}\n\nUsing the prior reasoning above as reference context only, produce your best available answer to the user's request now. Do not continue or extend reasoning.`,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
        };
        ```
        Then construct a FRESH Context COPY (PRD §53 h3.73 ephemeral/scoping — must NOT mutate the original):
        ```ts
        const replacementContext: Context = { ...context, messages: [...context.messages, directiveMessage] };
        ```
      - WHEN shouldInject is FALSE: `const replacementContext = context;` (same reference — preserves observational equivalence, ADR-005).
      - Options: `const replacementOptions = { ...options, reasoning: undefined };` (existing INV-014 — fresh object, original unmutated).
      - maxTokens bound (PRD §25.6 h2.97 + Appendix P.3 h2.236): if `replacementOptions.maxTokens === undefined`, set a sane default (e.g. 16384). z.ai does NOT reliably enforce this; rely on the stream's terminal event for completion. Preserve any caller-supplied maxTokens.
      - Debug milestone: `this.diagnostics.debug('request.replacement-built', {})` (privacy — {} only, Appendix H h2.203).
      - Return `{ model, context: replacementContext, options: replacementOptions }`.
   c) JSDOC REWRITE: Remove ALL 'NOT read in MVP' / 'reserved for forward-compat' language from the module JSDoc and method JSDoc. Document: (1) directive construction from the snapshot; (2) the TWO distinct uses of one snapshot — INPUT injection (here) vs OUTPUT stitching (already done in proxy); (3) the gated fallback (disabled/empty → omitted, same-ref context); (4) INV-014 options-level scoping; (5) the maxTokens best-effort caveat; (6) the non-continuation positioning (§26 / h1.37).
   d) PURITY: The method must remain a pure transform (PRD §31 h2.121 'Non-responsibilities: Network, Streaming, Retries'). It constructs fresh objects; it must NOT mutate inputs.
4. OUTPUT: `buildReplacement` now reads `reasoningSnapshot`, renders it, and injects it as ephemeral context when gated. The `ReplacementRequest.context` is a fresh augmented copy when injection is active (same-ref when omitted). INV-013 is mechanically satisfied (reasoning is reused, not discarded, by default).
5. MOCKING: No external services in the builder itself. The builder is pure — no network, no streaming. Tests (P2.M3.T1.S2) call buildReplacement directly with hand-built snapshots.
6. DOCS: [Mode A] Rewrite ALL JSDoc in src/request/builder.ts as described in logic step (c). This rides WITH the work — do not create a separate docs subtask.

subtasks.title: RequestBuilder directive + invariant tests (INV-013, INV-014)
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/002_de5c3dc3c05f/architecture/directive_design.md §8 for the exact test contract. See plan/002_de5c3dc3c05f/architecture/current-impl-state.md §5 for test helpers: makeCaptureDiag() (capturing Diagnostics stub), makeModel() (minimal Model<Api> with zai/openai-completions/glm-4.7), makeContext() (minimal Context with systemPrompt + messages). Existing builder tests are at tests/request-builder.test.ts.
2. INPUT: From P2.M2.T2.S1 — RequestBuilder constructor accepts (diagnostics, reasoningInjection?, delimiter?) and buildReplacement now reads reasoningSnapshot. The ThinkingEntry type from src/buffer/index.ts. ReasoningBuffer.snapshot() for constructing realistic snapshots.
3. LOGIC: Implement PRD §55 h2.178/h2.179 + §48 h1.68 acceptance + Appendix O h1.121 invariants:
   a) DIRECTIVE CONTENT (non-empty snapshot + injection enabled): buildReplacement returns triple.context as a NEW reference (NOT toBe original); triple.context.messages.length === original + 1; last message is UserMessage with role 'user'; content contains the rendered reasoning wrapped in the delimiter fence + the positioning instruction ('produce your best available answer... Do not continue or extend reasoning').
   b) GATED FALLBACK — DISABLED (reasoningInjection: false + non-empty snapshot): triple.context IS the same reference (toBe); no directive message appended; options.reasoning still undefined.
   c) GATED FALLBACK — EMPTY (reasoningInjection: true + empty snapshot []): triple.context IS the same reference (toBe); no directive message appended.
   d) NON-MUTATION (PRD §53 h3.73): after buildReplacement, the original context object is unchanged — same messages array length, same array reference, same systemPrompt. The original options object is NOT mutated (reasoning level intact if it was set).
   e) PRIVACY (Appendix H h2.203): the 'request.replacement-built' debug event fields are {} — no reasoning text, no directive text, no prompt content leaks.
   f) INV-013 (h2.232): by DEFAULT (reasoningInjection: true, constructor default), a non-empty snapshot produces an augmented context with the directive — reasoning is reused, not discarded.
   g) INV-014 (h2.233): triple.options.reasoning === undefined (fresh options); original options object is NOT mutated; the directive message in context does NOT carry any reasoning-level field (it's just message content — reasoning on/off is a per-request option independent of message content).
   h) maxTokens: when original options has no maxTokens, triple.options.maxTokens is set to the bounded default; when original options HAS maxTokens, it is preserved.
   i) EXISTING TESTS: the existing context-identity assertions (triple.context === context with empty [] snapshot) still pass — injection is omitted for empty snapshots. Update any constructor calls to match the new signature (defaults preserve existing behavior when omitted).
4. OUTPUT: tests/request-builder.test.ts has comprehensive directive coverage. `bun test tests/request-builder.test.ts` exits 0. INV-013 and INV-014 are defended against future regressions.
5. MOCKING: No external services. Tests call buildReplacement directly with hand-built snapshots. The capturing Diagnostics stub records debug calls for privacy assertion.
6. DOCS: none — test code only.
